headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jacob Gonzalez also had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. In other action, the Chicago Cubs took down the Minnesota Twins 6-2 behind a strong performance from Matthew Boyd, while the Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Mets 6-1 behind a strong outing from Jesús Luzardo.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. Other players on the injured list include Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Jeff Criswell of the Colorado Rockies, Sal Frelick of the Milwaukee Brewers, Oneil Cruz of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Chris Bassitt of the Baltimore Orioles, and JoJo Romero of the St. Louis Cardinals.

The Chicago Cubs made a notable trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, acquiring outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The St. Louis Cardinals traded for right-handed pitcher Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired center fielder Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jacob Gonzalez also had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their winning streak. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Mets 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Mets, winning 6-1 behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo, who earned the win with 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 2 H. Trea Turner led the Mets with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Placed on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. The injury occurred on July 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale in a trade with the Athletics. Civale joins the Cubs in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
